application.releaseStatus: Unreleased A06.1 development draft stacked on A05; historical releases unchanged.

scope: One adaptable synthetic AB/ab x ab/ab test cross. Manual activity configuration, not an application import/scenario format.

modelChecks.limits: Two autosomal loci, shared r 0–50 whole percentages, 1–1000 offspring, seed 0–4294967295, first 64 phased offspring displayed. Uninformative homozygous markers, finite observed proportions, phase and nonmetric marker spacing remain explicit.

handout.generator: tools/render-linkage.mjs from activity.json through the app worksheet renderer; Edge Print / Save as PDF at 100%.
handout.renderer: Poppler pdftoppm at 1350-pixel page height; pypdf paper/text/role checks.
handout.teacherAnswers: teacher-notes.md, separate from the student handout

limits: Synthetic phase/segregation/recombination probabilities, not tree genotypes, a rate estimate, physical/map distance, crossover count, sex-specific model or breeding system. Model r is capped at 50%; finite observed recombinant fractions may exceed it. The test-cross example is finite, with no continuing lesson/support commitment.
